items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Actually it was written by my first wife, whose name was June Evans

ctx.x: It was called 'Under the Sweetheart Tree.' Actually it was written by my first wife, whose name was June Evans, and she played the piano, very beautiful classical piano, and she was interested in arranging and composing music. She was very highly inspired by Duke Ellington and Lionel Hampton, the combination of the two. And she was a very good classical pianist.

And I recorded this song that she wrote, and it was called 'Under the Sweetheart Tree,' featuring Coleman Hawkins on these Vanguard recordings. And it was these recordings with him, and the ones that I'd done with Charlie Parker earlier, which featured Charlie Parker as a member of my group, that to me were some of the highlights of my arranging and recording with my own group. You see what I mean?
